meeting_schedule.note: Cadence after September TBD with Dr. Brown

weeks.title: Project Setup & Data Reconciliation
weeks.meeting_agenda: Introductory thesis meeting: present updated timeline, discuss IRB strategy for Time-Activity Supplement, agree on communication expectations

tasks.task: Set up thesis GitHub repository with project structure (R project, docs, data, outputs folders)
Export BREATHE-CC data dictionary from REDCap production
Reconcile Time-Activity Supplement fields against existing data dictionary (identify duplicates marked with warning)
Check approved BREATHE-CC consent language: does it cover address collection and geocoding beyond primary residence?
Begin systematic literature search in PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science for IEI-relevant papers
Set up Zotero collection for thesis references
Set up this thesis dashboard and populate with all tasks

key_decisions: Determine if IRB modification or consent addendum is needed based on existing consent language

weeks.title: Literature Search & IRB Submission Prep
weeks.meeting_agenda: Report on data dictionary reconciliation, IRB strategy decision, literature search progress

tasks.task: Continue literature search: time-weighted exposure models, indoor/outdoor integration, spatial interpolation in health studies
Annotate first 12-15 sources with structured relevance notes
Draft IRB modification narrative for Time-Activity Supplement (instrument description, methodological justification, data security plan for addresses)
Commission Spanish translation of Time-Activity Supplement (start in parallel with IRB prep)
Begin downloading TCEQ/EPA monitoring station data for Corpus Christi region (PM2.5, PM10, O3, SO2)

key_decisions: Finalize IRB modification vs. consent addendum approach

weeks.title: Annotated Bibliography Due / IRB Submission
weeks.meeting_agenda: Review annotated bibliography draft, finalize IRB submission package

tasks.task: Finalize and submit annotated bibliography (25+ sources)
Submit IRB modification package (English instrument PDF, Spanish translation, modification narrative, data security addendum if needed)
Begin literature review outline: organize sources by theme (exposure assessment methods, indoor modeling, composite indices, time-activity patterns, pediatric asthma epidemiology)
Continue ambient data download and cleaning

weeks.title: Literature Review Writing Begins
weeks.meeting_agenda: Lit review outline review, discuss ambient data pipeline progress, IRB submission confirmation

tasks.task: Write lit review Section 1: Background on ambient air pollution and childhood asthma (outdoor exposure epidemiology)
Write lit review Section 2: Indoor exposure sources and respiratory outcomes
Set up R project for kriging pipeline: import monitoring station coordinates, configure spatial packages (sp, gstat, sf)
Clean and format TCEQ/EPA data: monthly averages by station, handle missing data

weeks.title: Literature Review & Kriging Pipeline
weeks.meeting_agenda: Lit review draft sections 1-2, kriging pipeline demo, IRB status check

tasks.task: Write lit review Section 3: Time-activity patterns and microenvironment exposure modeling
Write lit review Section 4: Composite exposure indices and the methodological gap
Build ordinary kriging pipeline for PM2.5 surface generation (variogram fitting, cross-validation)
Extend kriging to O3, SO2, PM10 surfaces

weeks.title: Indoor Scoring & Infiltration Modeling
weeks.meeting_agenda: Lit review progress, kriging results review, indoor modeling approach

tasks.task: Build indoor survey scoring module: secondhand smoke, gas cooking, mold/dampness, ventilation quality scoring algorithms
Develop infiltration factor model: AC type + window behavior -> F_inf lookup table based on literature values
Implement indoor concentration model: C_indoor = F_inf * C_ambient + C_source
Revise literature review based on Dr. Brown feedback
Check IRB modification status (expect 2-4 week turnaround from Week 3 submission)

key_decisions: Finalize infiltration factor values from literature for South Texas climate

weeks.title: Literature Review Due / IEI Composite Construction
weeks.meeting_agenda: Submit literature review, present composite IEI construction methodology

tasks.task: Finalize and submit literature review
Integrate outdoor + indoor components into composite IEI score function
Implement time-weighting logic: use literature-based default time-activity patterns until participant data available
If IRB approved: deploy Time-Activity Supplement to REDCap development copy for testing

key_decisions: Define default time-activity assumptions from literature for preliminary IEI

weeks.title: IEI Validation & Sensitivity Analysis
weeks.meeting_agenda: IEI pipeline demo on test data, sensitivity analysis plan, begin manuscript discussion

tasks.task: Run IEI computation on available BREATHE-CC participants using literature-based time-activity assumptions
Sensitivity analysis 1: compare IDW vs. ordinary kriging vs. universal kriging for ambient surfaces
Sensitivity analysis 2: vary indoor/outdoor weighting schemes
Compare IEI to single-pollutant exposure measures (correlation, rank agreement)
Begin manuscript Introduction section
If IRB approved: test Time-Activity Supplement end-to-end in REDCap dev, verify all calc fields and branching

key_decisions: Select preferred spatial interpolation method based on LOOCV results

weeks.title: Multi-Household Logic & Manuscript Writing
weeks.meeting_agenda: Sensitivity analysis results, manuscript outline review, multi-household weighting approach

tasks.task: Implement multi-household time-weighting: split home microenvironments by nights_primary/nights_secondary
Write manuscript Methods section: IEI construction, spatial methods, indoor modeling, time-weighting, sensitivity framework
Document all pipeline code with inline comments and README
If approved: deploy Time-Activity Supplement to production, begin fielding to enrolled participants
Identify target journal (e.g., Environmental Health Perspectives, Environment International) and format requirements

key_decisions: Select target journal for IEI methods manuscript

weeks.title: Manuscript Draft Due
weeks.meeting_agenda: Review manuscript draft, discuss preliminary results, plan outcome analysis approach

tasks.task: Finalize and submit IEI manuscript draft (Introduction + Methods, formatted for target journal)
Push complete IEI pipeline to GitHub with documentation, sample outputs, and reproducibility instructions
Begin exploratory bivariate analyses: IEI scores vs. exacerbation counts (descriptive statistics, scatter plots)

deliverables: IEI Manuscript Draft (20% of Fall grade)

weeks.title: Outcome Analysis Setup & Manuscript Revision
weeks.meeting_agenda: Manuscript feedback discussion, outcome analysis methodology review

tasks.task: Set up Poisson/negative binomial regression framework for monthly exacerbation counts
Set up linear mixed model framework for repeated C-ACT scores
Incorporate committee feedback on manuscript draft
Run preliminary adjusted models with available covariates (income, education, insurance, housing tenure, food insecurity)

key_decisions: Finalize covariate set for adjusted models

weeks.title: Preliminary Results & Presentation Prep
weeks.meeting_agenda: Preliminary outcome results, presentation outline review

tasks.task: Run preliminary outcome analyses and document results (even if sample size is limited)
Begin GBTM exploration: fit trajectory models with 2-4 groups on available wheezing data
Start building Fall Progress Presentation slides
Outline spring semester plan based on fall progress and remaining work
Finalize Fall Progress Presentation: IEI development summary, validation results, preliminary outcome methods, spring plan
Practice presentation timing (target 20-25 minutes + Q&A)
Prepare supplementary materials for committee review

weeks.title: Fall Progress Presentation
weeks.meeting_agenda: Deliver Fall Progress Presentation to thesis committee

tasks.task: Deliver Fall Progress Presentation to thesis committee
Document committee feedback and action items for spring
Create spring semester detailed task plan based on feedback

key_decisions: Confirm spring semester meeting cadence with Dr. Brown
deliverables: Fall Progress Presentation (15% of Fall grade)

tasks.task: Incorporate presentation feedback into pipeline and manuscript
Final GitHub push with end-of-semester documentation
Archive fall semester deliverables
Continue reading: GBTM methodology papers, pediatric asthma phenotyping literature
Review and clean any Time-Activity Supplement responses received so far
Outline health outcome analysis pipeline structure
Rest and recharge

weeks.title: Spring Kickoff
weeks.meeting_agenda: Review fall progress, discuss spring plan, set meeting cadence, review Time-Activity Supplement data collected so far

tasks.task: Review all fall pipeline outputs and committee feedback
Inventory available Time-Activity Supplement responses; assess sample size for participant-level time-weighting
If sufficient TA data: recalculate IEI using participant-reported time-activity instead of literature defaults
Plan health outcome analysis strategy with updated data

key_decisions: Determine if enough TA supplement data exists to replace literature-based assumptions

weeks.title: Exacerbation Count Modeling
weeks.meeting_agenda: Present updated IEI with any participant TA data, exacerbation modeling approach

tasks.task: Build Poisson/negative binomial regression pipeline for monthly exacerbation counts with IEI as primary predictor
Implement covariate adjustment: household income, parental education, insurance status, housing tenure, food insecurity
Test for overdispersion; select Poisson vs. negative binomial
Revise IEI manuscript Introduction based on committee feedback

key_decisions: Poisson vs. negative binomial model selection

weeks.title: C-ACT Score Analysis
weeks.meeting_agenda: Exacerbation model results, C-ACT analysis plan

tasks.task: Build linear mixed model pipeline for repeated C-ACT scores (random intercept for participant, IEI as fixed effect)
Handle missing data strategy (multiple imputation vs. complete case analysis)
Run sensitivity checks on model specifications (random slope vs. intercept only)

weeks.title: GBTM Phenotyping
weeks.meeting_agenda: C-ACT results, GBTM methodology review

tasks.task: Run Group-Based Trajectory Modeling for wheezing phenotype identification (test 2, 3, 4 group solutions)
Model selection: BIC, entropy, average posterior probability, group size criteria
Characterize trajectory groups descriptively

key_decisions: Number of trajectory groups for GBTM

weeks.title: IEI as Trajectory Predictor
weeks.meeting_agenda: GBTM results, IEI-trajectory associations, overall analysis progress

tasks.task: Test IEI as predictor of trajectory group membership (multinomial logistic regression)
Run subgroup analyses by demographics and housing type
Begin documenting all pipeline code for reproducibility (comments, README, sample data)

weeks.title: Sensitivity Checks & Pipeline Documentation
weeks.meeting_agenda: Complete outcome analysis results review, sensitivity analysis plan

tasks.task: Run comprehensive sensitivity analyses across all three outcome models
Sensitivity on IEI construction: re-run outcomes with different IEI weighting schemes
Document all pipeline decisions, assumptions, and limitations
Prepare pipeline draft for submission

weeks.title: Health Outcome Pipeline Draft Due
weeks.meeting_agenda: Submit pipeline draft, discuss results interpretation, manuscript revision plan

tasks.task: Submit Health Outcome Analysis Pipeline Draft: documented code, sample outputs, sensitivity results
Begin revising IEI manuscript Methods with final pipeline details
Add Results section to manuscript with preliminary outcome findings (with sample size caveats)

deliverables: Health Outcome Pipeline Draft (10% of Spring grade)

weeks.title: Manuscript Revision Push
weeks.meeting_agenda: Pipeline feedback, manuscript revision progress

tasks.task: Incorporate committee feedback on pipeline draft
Write manuscript Discussion section: interpret IEI in context of existing literature, state limitations (sample size, data availability, seasonal generalizability)
Write manuscript Abstract and Conclusion
Continue manuscript revision (use break for uninterrupted writing time)
Format manuscript per target journal submission guidelines
Begin brainstorming poster layout and key figures

weeks.title: Final Manuscript Push
weeks.meeting_agenda: Near-final manuscript review, poster planning

tasks.task: Final manuscript revisions incorporating all committee feedback
Prepare figures and tables for journal submission
Begin research poster design: key findings, IEI methodology figure, results summary

weeks.title: Manuscript Submission Prep
weeks.meeting_agenda: Final manuscript review before committee submission, poster draft

tasks.task: Submit finalized manuscript to committee for final review
Finalize health outcome pipeline with committee revisions
Continue poster design with preliminary data visualizations

weeks.meeting_agenda: Confirm manuscript finalization, pipeline revisions, poster feedback

If committee approves: submit to target journal for peer review
Incorporate feedback into poster

Present poster at Rollins Honors Summit (if scheduled this week)
